item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 03/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, a trough of low pressure will develop over central China and is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong later on Monday to Tuesday. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will be hot with a few showers over the region.
